subject: Request: one-week pilot runway while PO processes
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@novapath.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@novapath.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-week pilot runway while PO processes

Hi Markus —

Quick note from procurement: our PO is in routing and vendor onboarding, but finance just told us the approval queue will take another 5–7 business days. We’re mid-sprint on the integration and losing momentum; could Redwood extend the pilot for one week (or grant a short token top-up) while the PO clears?

We can send a PO stub and confirm vendor details to speed the process. Appreciate any temporary runway you can provide — it makes a big difference to our engineering team.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Park
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaPath Health
sam.park@novapath.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: novapath_po_stub.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@novapath.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-week pilot runway while PO processes

Camila / Laura —

Looping you in. Sam at NovaPath says procurement routing will take another 5–7 business days and asked for a one-week extension or token top-up to keep their engineers running. Deal is DEAL-8731 (pilot, 25 seats).

Proposed temporary fix: a 7-calendar-day runway voucher that preserves their sandbox state and grants 100k tokens for the pilot. No long-term price impact; mark as one-off grace credit tied to the PO. I drafted a small voucher PDF for signature (attached). If we approve, I’ll send the DocuSign link and confirm exact token allotment in the portal.

Questions for approval:
- Laura: OK to approve a one-off 7-day voucher for this tier?
- Camila: confirm the token amount and whether we should require the PO stub before granting.

If you greenlight, I’ll reply to Sam and include the DocuSign link.

—Markus
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: proposed-7day-voucher.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@novapath.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-week pilot runway while PO processes

On Fri, Aug 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Camila / Laura —
> 
> Looping you in. Sam at NovaPath says procurement routing will take another 5–7 business days and asked for a one-week extension or token top-up to keep their engineers running.

Thanks for the summary, Markus. Approved from me to grant the runway. Suggested changes: make it 7 calendar days but tie tokens to usage (100k max) and expire if PO not received within 14 days. Ask for the PO stub up front; that gives legal/finance a nudge.

Sam — thank you for the heads up. We’ll issue a one-week runway voucher (100k tokens) immediately upon receipt of the PO stub and a short confirmation from procurement that Novapath is actively routing. If you can cc procurement@novapath.com and reply with a stub, we’ll fast-track the DocuSign and push the token bundle live in the portal same day.

Next steps:
1) Sam: reply-all with PO stub (or confirmation that it’s in the routing queue).
2) Markus: once stub received, send DocuSign link for the one-off voucher.
3) Camila: I’ll monitor usage and follow up with finance if PO stalls longer than 14 days.

—Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@novapath.com>, procurement@novapath.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-week pilot runway while PO processes

Sam — thanks for sending the stub and the confirmation that procurement has the PO in vendor onboarding. We’ve approved a one-week runway voucher per Camila’s note. Details below and voucher attached.

Voucher: NovaPath 7-day Runway (one-off)
- Token allowance: 100,000 tokens (soft cap)
- Valid: 7 calendar days from activation
- Expiration for issuance: voucher must be signed/activated within 14 days of today

I’ve attached the DocuSign link; please sign the voucher and we’ll activate tokens in the portal within business hours of receipt. If procurement needs any additional vendor paperwork, loop Camila and I and we’ll coordinate with legal/finance.

Activation link (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.net/secure/recipient?env=demo&token=ABC123-VOUCHER
HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-8731

Attachments: novapath-7day-runway-token.txt (activation and voucher terms)

Thanks — we’ll keep the pilot warm.
